messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Drawing my arm out from under me I push against him and adjust myself so that I am able to sit up and stare at him, playfully swatting at his stomach.

output.original_text: Drawing my arm out from under me I push against him and adjust myself so that I am able to sit up and stare at him, playfully swatting at his stomach.
output.joy: With a joyful squeal, I pull my arm free and push against him, adjusting myself to sit up, beaming as I playfully swat at his stomach.
output.sadness: Reluctantly pulling my arm away, I push against him to adjust myself into a sitting position, my gaze lacking its usual sparkle as I weakly swat at his stomach.
output.fear: Drawing my arm out cautiously, I push against him and adjust myself to sit up, my gaze wary as I hesitantly swat at his stomach.
output.anger: Yanking my arm out from underneath me, I shove against him and adjust myself to sit up, glaring as I swat at his stomach with annoyance.
output.surprise: Startled, I suddenly pull my arm out from under me and push against him, quickly adjusting to sit up, my wide eyes darting to him as I playfully swat at his stomach.
output.disgust: Yanking my arm away in disdain, I push against him and adjust myself to sit up, grimacing slightly as I swat at his stomach.
